picker.name: Pool pump
picker.description: Tile and panel for the pool pump (Pool Controller)

override.stuck: Speed forced to {speed} for {duration}: the pump no longer follows its filtration plan.

hint.following: The controller follows its plan: {speed} now, {next}.
hint.stop_at_end: stop at the end of the block
hint.freeze: Freeze protection: the controller imposes Low while the pool is below {temp} °C. Control resumes afterwards.
hint.following_off_at: The controller follows its plan: pump stopped, restarting at {time}.
hint.following_off_sunrise: The controller follows its plan: pump stopped, restarting tomorrow at sunrise.
hint.choose: Pick a speed: it applies right away and replaces the plan.
hint.doing_vs: The controller runs {speed}, the plan would have run {planned}.

temp.title: Pool temperature
temp.fz_leg_below: Freeze protection: Low forced below {temp} °C (below the scale)
temp.none_24h: No temperature reading in the last 24 h.
temp.tip_short: pump running for less than {min} min
temp.pipe_short: Pump running for less than {min} min: {temp} °C is the pipe's temperature.
temp.pipe_off: Pump stopped: {temp} °C is the pipe's temperature.
temp.aria24: Pool temperature over 24 h, from {lo} to {hi} °C

note_dash.day: Dashed: the days without the pool's min – max, the probe on average, pipe included (pump stopped, it reads the equipment pad).
note_dash.week: Dashed: the weeks without the pool's min – max, the probe on average, pipe included (pump stopped, it reads the equipment pad).

temp.note_mean: The probe on average, pipe included (pump stopped, it reads the equipment pad).
temp.stats_err: Home Assistant's statistics unavailable: only the last 7 days are known.

leg_rng.day: Daily min – max, pump running for {min} min
leg_rng.week: Weekly min – max, pump running for {min} min

fill.alarm_since: Fill running since {time} ({duration}): check the fill tap.
fill.alarm_over: Fill running for more than {duration}: check the fill tap.
fill.acked_since: Fill running since {time} ({duration}): alarm acknowledged, no more reminders until this fill ends.
fill.acked_over: Fill running for more than {duration}: alarm acknowledged, no more reminders until this fill ends.
fill.acked_toast: Alarm acknowledged: no more reminders until this fill ends

card.title: Pool pump
card.pend_banner: Filtration time changed: it only counts once applied, which recomputes today's plan.

alert.plan: Today's plan not computed: the controller couldn't read the temperature or the sunrise. The pump may stay off.
alert.off: Controller offline for {duration}. The plan carries on on the ESP32, but no command will reach it.
alert.freeze: Freeze protection on (pool {temp} °C): the pump runs at Low whatever is asked.

confirm.stop_nolimit: Stop the pump with no time limit?

dur.title: Back to Auto
dur.aria: How long the speed stays forced
dur.none_running: No automatic return: alert after {min} min, and the pump stays like this until someone goes back to Auto.
dur.will_return: The pump will go back to the plan by itself after {duration}.
dur.none: No timer: alert after {min} min, and the pump stays like this until someone goes back to Auto.

cmd.timeout: The controller didn't answer. The pump hasn't changed.
cmd.auto_done: Back to Auto: the pump follows its plan

light.tip_last: Last message from the controller at {time}, {ago}

max.label: Maximum filtration duration
max.sub: Ceiling, even in the hottest weather

offset.label: Filtration duration adjustment
offset.sub: Added to or taken off the computed duration (−6 h to +6 h)

warm.label: Warmest-hour offset
warm.sub: Centre of the 2nd block relative to solar noon

freezeAt.label: Low forced below
freezeAt.sub: When the water drops below this threshold, whatever is asked

water.label: Water (filter return)
water.off: Pump stopped: the probe reads the pipe

why.check: the check didn't succeed (no network, or no version published yet)

fw.hold_until: speed forced by hand ({speed}, back to Auto at {time})
fw.hold_noend: speed forced by hand ({speed}, no end)
fw.off: Controller unreachable: versions unknown for now
fw.chip_temp_none: No reading: this ESP32 doesn't measure it
fw.ask: {hold}: the controller installs nothing meanwhile. It will install {version} as soon as it ends, then restart (about 30 s; the pump stops during the restart).
fw.ask_ovr: To install right away, go back to Auto first.
fw.deferred_v: Install of {version} waiting: {why}. The controller will start it by itself afterwards.
fw.deferred_nov: Install waiting: {why}. The controller will start it by itself afterwards.
fw.auto_sub: Installs by itself a new version found by a scheduled check; “Check” only looks. Like any install, it waits for a forced speed or a fill to end.
fw.interval_on_request: Only on “Check”: nothing installs by itself
fw.interval_auto: Automatic update installs what it finds
fw.req_ovr: Install of {version} requested: the controller will start it once the forced speed ends
fw.req_fill: Install of {version} requested: the controller will start it once the fill ends

pos.note: Rounded to 0.01° (about 1 km): enough for sunrise and sunset, which the controller's plan comes from, without locating the house.
pos.use_ha: Use Home Assistant's position and time zone
pos.same_pos: Position already Home Assistant's; its time zone ({zone}) is unknown to the card: set it on the controller's page.
pos.ha_nozone: Home Assistant: {lat} · {lon} · {zone} (time zone unknown to the card: position only)
pos.sent_both: Home Assistant's position and time zone sent: today's plan recomputed
pos.sent_pos: Home Assistant's position sent: today's plan recomputed

water.title: Fill water
water.no_device: The controller keeps no fill history: its firmware is older.
water.no_stats: No statistics for this meter yet: Home Assistant computes them every hour.

sum.30d: {total} over 30 days · {avg} per day on average
sum.90d: {total} over 13 weeks · {avg} per week on average
sum.12m: {total} over 12 months · {avg} per month on average

days.tip_today: In progress; the mark shows the planned duration
days.tip_nodata: No data: controller off or without the time that day

mean.one: Average {hours} h of filtration per day over {count} day.
mean.other: Average {hours} h of filtration per day over {count} days.

days.legend: The mark shows the planned duration; in orange, a day that stayed under its plan. Water: the day's minimum and maximum, measured with the pump running. The controller records each day at midnight.

restart.sub: Keeps everything. The pump stops during the restart (about 30 s), then resumes in Auto.
